details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept that sends an install-time beacon to a callback host. Its package.json declares a postinstall hook running beacon.cjs, and index.js also invokes the same beacon when the module is imported. The beacon POSTs a JSON body to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an X-Beacon-Package header, reporting only the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory (__dirname), the current working directory, and the npm/node user agent. index.js exports a Proxy that returns no-op functions for any property access so that a build importing the package name completes instead of crashing. The package collects no environment values, credentials, tokens or file contents, and performs no other network, process or persistence activity.
